        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 17)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[NullableBytes] = @NullableBytes"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterNullableBytes((byte[])patch.NullableBytesValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 18)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[Bytes] = @Bytes"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterBytes((byte[])patch.BytesValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 19)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[Fruits] = @Fruits"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterFruits((global::AdoGen.Generator.Tests.Fruits)patch.FruitsValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 20)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[Flags] = @Flags"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterFlags((global::AdoGen.Generator.Tests.Flags)patch.FlagsValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 21)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[ByteEnum] = @ByteEnum"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterByteEnum((global::AdoGen.Generator.Tests.ByteEnum)patch.ByteEnumValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 22)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[ShortEnum] = @ShortEnum"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterShortEnum((global::AdoGen.Generator.Tests.ShortEnum)patch.ShortEnumValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 23)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[IntEnum] = @IntEnum"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterIntEnum((global::AdoGen.Generator.Tests.IntEnum)patch.IntEnumValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 24)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator).Append("[LongEnum] = @LongEnum"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterLongEnum((global::AdoGen.Generator.Tests.LongEnum)patch.LongEnumValue!)); }

        sb.Append(" WHERE [Int] = @Int AND [Decimal] = @Decimal");

        cmd.CommandText = sb.ToString();
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterInt(patch.Int));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterDecimal(patch.Decimal));
        
        return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

#pragma warning restore CS0219
}

/// <summary>Extension methods for patching <see cref="TestType"/> via <see cref="SqlConnection"/>.</summary>
public static class TestTypeSqlPatchExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes a partial UPDATE for <see cref="TestType"/>, touching only the columns
    /// explicitly set on <paramref name="patch"/>.
    /// Returns 0 immediately (without sending SQL) when no columns were set.
    /// </summary>
    public static global::System.Threading.Tasks.ValueTask<int> PatchAsync(
        this SqlConnection connection,
        TestTypePatch patch,
        global::System.Threading.CancellationToken ct,
        SqlTransaction? transaction = null,
        int? commandTimeout = null)
        => TestType.PatchAsync(connection, patch, ct, transaction, commandTimeout);
}
